description: Google Trends for 1-5 keywords in any country or worldwide: relative search interest over time (0-100), interest by region, and top and rising related queries (incl. Breakout). Provided by Atlas Data (third-party seller) from its Google Trends scraper; cached up to 6 h. Relative interest, not absolute search volume. Price 0.03 USD per call via x402.

compare.description: Scale keywords relative to each other (Google compare view) instead of independently

geo.description: ISO country code (DK, SE, NO, US), region (US-CA) or US metro (US-NY-501). Omit for worldwide.

keywords.description: Comma-separated keywords, 1-5 (e.g. "bitcoin,ethereum"); max 100 chars each; no URLs

maxItems.description: Max regions and related queries per list per keyword (default 10, clamped to 20). The full time series is always returned.

name: google_trends
